Hey Rod, Kim and the Custom Assured team,

Your reviews tell the same story: the same technician comes back twice a year, and you call them when it's time. One customer says they try to send the same technicians out every time. My daughter and I build websites for service businesses, so we made you a mockup built around it:

https://customassured-fortwayne.websitepreview.fluidframemarketing.com/?utm_source=form

Note: It'll look a lot better with your logo and images on it! Lol

The preview opens with a recent case study, then walks through why each page is built the way it is. One thing we'd fix: your phone number isn't tappable on a phone, and your homepage doesn't show it at all.

We built your homepage and your HVAC maintenance page as examples, and we'd love to build the rest. Bryant is on your site. Which other brands or manufacturers are you certified with?

By the way, our contact form system would have recognized this as a solicitation, and you wouldn't have even seen it.

How'd we do on your company vibe?

Josh
